dialogues.jp:
テストも終わり、ぬるったい日差しに誘われて
ふらりと外に出てみたりなんかして。
dialogues.en:
The exams were over, and the sun was inviting me to come out
and enjoy it's rays.
dialogues.text:
The exams were over, and the sun was inviting me to come out
and enjoy it's rays.

dialogues.jp:
心地好くあたたかな空気がゆったりと頬をくす
ぐりながら流れていく。
dialogues.en:
The pleasant, warm air felt good on my cheeks as the wind
blew past.
dialogues.text:
The pleasant, warm air felt good on my cheeks as the wind
blew past.

dialogues.jp:
ついこの間まで、冷たい風に身をちぢこめてい
たのがまるで嘘のように、陽気はすっかり春だっ
た。
dialogues.en:
Compared to the previously harsh winter winds, this was
definite proof that spring had arrived.
dialogues.text:
Compared to the previously harsh winter winds, this was
definite proof that spring had arrived.

dialogues.jp: 満ち足りた気分で大｛あくび／欠伸｝を放つ。
dialogues.en:
I contentedly walked around aimlessly, letting out a big
yawn.
dialogues.text:
I contentedly walked around aimlessly, letting out a big
yawn.

dialogues.jp: （っと……ヨダレ出ちまった）
dialogues.en: "(Doh... drool is coming out.)"
dialogues.text: "(Doh... drool is coming out.)"

dialogues.jp:
……ちょっとみっともない気もするが、見知っ
た顔もないことだし構わないだろう。
dialogues.en:
...Well, if no one I know is around, it shouldn't matter too
much to leave it there.
dialogues.text:
...Well, if no one I know is around, it shouldn't matter too
much to leave it there.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「あれ、朝倉」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Asakura."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「おわっと！」
dialogues.en: "Wahhh!"
dialogues.text: "Wahhh!"

dialogues.jp: ……なんて余裕をかましていたら――――。
dialogues.en: ...As if to prove me wrong---
dialogues.text: ...As if to prove me wrong---

dialogues.jp: 見知った顔がいた。
dialogues.en: a face I did recognize popped up.
dialogues.text: a face I did recognize popped up.

dialogues.jp: 「よ、よう、工藤」
dialogues.en: "H, hi, Kudou."
dialogues.text: "H, hi, Kudou."

dialogues.jp:
慌ててゆるんだ口元を袖でぬぐい、平静を装っ
て挨拶をかえす。
dialogues.en:
I hurriedly wiped my mouth with my sleeve, giving as calm a
greeting as possible.
dialogues.text:
I hurriedly wiped my mouth with my sleeve, giving as calm a
greeting as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「散歩でもしてるのか？」
dialogues.en: "Taking a stroll?"
dialogues.text: "Taking a stroll?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「ん〜と……そう見えるんなら、きっとそうな
　んだろうよ」
dialogues.en:
"Uhhmm... if that's what it looks like, then that's what it
must be."
dialogues.text:
"Uhhmm... if that's what it looks like, then that's what it
must be."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「なんだそれ、訳わかんねーな」
dialogues.en: "I reaaaally don't understand what you say sometimes."
dialogues.text: "I reaaaally don't understand what you say sometimes."

dialogues.jp:
俺の、のらくらした返答に｛いぶか／訝｝しげな視線をむけ
る工藤。
dialogues.en: My non-commital reply was viewed on quite suspiciously.
dialogues.text: My non-commital reply was viewed on quite suspiciously.

dialogues.jp:
そう言われても……ただ外の空気が吸いたくて
外へ出ただけだからなぁ。どう表現したものや
ら。
dialogues.en:
Really... I just came out to enjoy the spring air. And
that's what it looked like, right?
dialogues.text:
Really... I just came out to enjoy the spring air. And
that's what it looked like, right?

dialogues.jp: 「お前は？」
dialogues.en: "What about you?"
dialogues.text: "What about you?"

dialogues.jp: と、逆に質問を返してはぐらかす。
dialogues.en: I returned the question back to him.
dialogues.text: I returned the question back to him.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「家の者に頼まれて、和菓子を注文しに来たん
　だ。おばあさまが……」
dialogues.en:
"My parents sent me on an errand to delivery some wagashis
to my grandmother's house..."
dialogues.text:
"My parents sent me on an errand to delivery some wagashis
to my grandmother's house..."

dialogues.jp: と言いかけて一瞬口ごもる工藤。
dialogues.en: Realizing what it might sound like, he quickly followed up.
dialogues.text: Realizing what it might sound like, he quickly followed up.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……祖母が茶事に使うんでね」
dialogues.en: "...She uses them to make tea."
dialogues.text: "...She uses them to make tea."

dialogues.jp:
茶事……か。やっぱりコイツ、やんごとなき家
柄の出みたいだなぁ。
dialogues.en:
Tea-making, eh. This guy really must come from one of those
dignified families.
dialogues.text:
Tea-making, eh. This guy really must come from one of those
dignified families.

dialogues.en: "(.........wagashis, huh.)"
dialogues.text: "(.........wagashis, huh.)"

dialogues.jp:
俺は自分の｛てのひら／掌｝を見つめ、なんとはなしに、にぱ
にぱと開閉してみる。
dialogues.en: I stared at my palm, opening and closing it a few times.
dialogues.text: I stared at my palm, opening and closing it a few times.

dialogues.jp:
茶事に使うような和菓子ってったら、フツーの
大福やどら焼きなんかじゃなくて季節の花を模っ
た練り切りとか――。
dialogues.en:
For tea-making, the wagashis used aren't normal sweets, but
imitations of seasonal flowers carefully kneaded and made--
dialogues.text:
For tea-making, the wagashis used aren't normal sweets, but
imitations of seasonal flowers carefully kneaded and made--

dialogues.jp:
あるいは『初音の三日月』とでも名前のついた
ご大層な創作菓子なんだろーな。
dialogues.en:
It's called "The first sign of a New Moon", an exquisite
pastry creation.
dialogues.text:
It's called "The first sign of a New Moon", an exquisite
pastry creation.

dialogues.jp: ……さすがに、そのへんは未開拓だ。
dialogues.en: ...Something like that is pretty rare to see.
dialogues.text: ...Something like that is pretty rare to see.

dialogues.jp: 「……力になれなくてすまんな」
dialogues.en: "...Sorry, I don't have enough power for that."
dialogues.text: "...Sorry, I don't have enough power for that."

dialogues.jp: 小さく頭を下げる俺。
dialogues.en: I bowed my head in apology."
dialogues.text: I bowed my head in apology."

dialogues.jp:
工藤はそんな俺の様子に不思議そうな声をあげ
て首をかしげていたが、
dialogues.en: Kudou looked at my appeareance quite weirdly.
dialogues.text: Kudou looked at my appeareance quite weirdly.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、また明日学園でな」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, I'd see you in school tomorrow."
dialogues.text: "Anyway, I'd see you in school tomorrow."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ああ」
dialogues.en: "Ahh."
dialogues.text: "Ahh."

dialogues.jp: さわやかな笑顔を残して去っていった。
dialogues.en: He left with his usual bright smile.
dialogues.text: He left with his usual bright smile.

dialogues.jp:
この世にはまだ口にしたことのない高級な和菓
子もいろいろと存在するのだな。
dialogues.en:
Indeed, in this world, there exists fare more high-class
wagashis than my own.
dialogues.text:
Indeed, in this world, there exists fare more high-class
wagashis than my own.

dialogues.jp: （今度、暇な時にでもチャレンジしてみるか）
dialogues.en: "(One of these days, I should challenge those people.)"
dialogues.text: "(One of these days, I should challenge those people.)"

dialogues.jp: レパートリーは多いほうがいいし、
dialogues.en: It'd be good to expand my repetoire.
dialogues.text: It'd be good to expand my repetoire.

dialogues.jp:
……なんて、女の子のようなことを考えながら、
俺はしばらくそのへんをあてもなく歩き続けた
のだった。
dialogues.en:
...Suddenly realizing that I was starting to sound like a
girl, I decided to continue on my stroll.
dialogues.text:
...Suddenly realizing that I was starting to sound like a
girl, I decided to continue on my stroll.

dialogues.jp: ◆高級和菓子◆
dialogues.en: ◆High-Class Wagashi◆
dialogues.text: ◆High-Class Wagashi◆

dialogues.jp: ぶらぶらと街を歩いていると、工藤に出会った。
dialogues.en: Walking down the road randomly, I met up with Kudou.
dialogues.text: Walking down the road randomly, I met up with Kudou.

dialogues.jp:
工藤は工藤の祖母ちゃんが茶事で使う和菓子を
注文に来たらしい。
dialogues.en:
Kudou came by request of his grandmother to deliver some
wagashis for tea-making to her.
dialogues.text:
Kudou came by request of his grandmother to deliver some
wagashis for tea-making to her.

dialogues.jp: 茶事なんて、やっぱいい家柄の家なんだろう。
dialogues.en: Tea-making... he must come from quite a dignified family.
dialogues.text: Tea-making... he must come from quite a dignified family.

dialogues.jp:
そんな家で出る、口にした事もないような高級
和菓子に想いを馳せながら、散歩を再開した俺
だった。
dialogues.en:
Eventually realizing I was thinking too much about wagashis,
I continued on with my walk.
dialogues.text:
Eventually realizing I was thinking too much about wagashis,
I continued on with my walk.
